axis: Cash withdrawals from bank deposits (صرف أموال المودعين)
what_varies: How much of their bank balances depositors can draw in cash.
states: capped at 80,000 riyals a day (80 ألف ريال يمني فقط يومياً) @ مناطق الحكومة الشرعية [YE-002, YE-003] | stopped since 2016 (توقفت عن صرف أموال المودعين منذ عام 2016) @ مناطق سيطرة الحوثيين [YE-004, YE-005]
today: capped at 80,000 riyals a day (80 ألف ريال يمني فقط يومياً) @ مناطق الحكومة الشرعية + stopped since 2016 (توقفت عن صرف أموال المودعين منذ عام 2016) @ مناطق سيطرة الحوثيين

axis: Payout currency of incoming remittances (تسليم الحوالات)
what_varies: In which currency a remittance from abroad is handed to the recipient.
states: paid in the currency received (بالعملة الواردة ذاتها) [YE-007] | US-dollar payout barred (منعوا تسليم الحوالات بالدولار الأميركي) @ مناطق سيطرة الحوثيين [YE-008]
today: paid in the currency received (بالعملة الواردة ذاتها) + US-dollar payout barred (منعوا تسليم الحوالات بالدولار الأميركي) @ مناطق سيطرة الحوثيين
note: The Aden central bank decision is stated to bind bank and exchange branches in Houthi-controlled areas too [YE-008].

what_varies: Where commercial banks keep their head offices, in fact or as required.
states: in Sana'a (مراكزها الرئيسية من مدينة صنعاء) [YE-009] | required in Aden by the Aden central bank (لنقل مقارها الرئيسية إلى عدن) [YE-009, YE-027, YE-040] | eight banks relocating to Aden (decision to relocate their headquarters from Houthi-controlled Sana'a to the interim capital, Aden) [YE-001]
today: eight banks relocating to Aden (decision to relocate their headquarters from Houthi-controlled Sana'a to the interim capital, Aden)

what_varies: The standing of the Aden central bank's unified network for money transfers.
states: run under Aden central bank instructions (التعليمات الخاصة بالشبكة المالية الموحدة) [YE-010] | restructuring under discussion (بحث إعادة هيكلة «شركة الشبكة الموحدة») [YE-048] | dealing with it banned (منع التعامل مع الشبكة الموحدة) @ صنعاء [YE-006] | restructured with the country's banks as shareholders (بانضمام البنوك العاملة في البلاد) [YE-034]
today: restructured with the country's banks as shareholders (بانضمام البنوك العاملة في البلاد)
note: The later whole-market state [YE-034] supersedes the Sana'a ban under rule 6; no source read says the ban was lifted.

axis: Riyal–US dollar exchange rate (سعر صرف الدولار)
what_varies: How many Yemeni riyals buy one US dollar.
states: 215 riyals per dollar (215 ريالاً يمنيًّا مقابل الدولار) [YE-015, YE-050] | 682 riyals per dollar (682 ريالاً يمنيًّا للدولار) @ عدن [YE-013] | 600 riyals per dollar (600 ريَال للدولار) @ صنعاء [YE-013] | 790 buy / 795 sell (790 ريالا شراء و795 رياال بيع) @ عدن [YE-024] | 601 buy / 603 sell (601 شراء و603 بيع) @ صنعاء [YE-024] | up to 1,700 riyals per dollar (up to YER 1,700) @ IRG-controlled territory [YE-051] | over 1,000 riyals per dollar (over YER 1,000) @ Aden [YE-053] | half the Aden rate (only half that much) @ Sana’a [YE-053] | 2,100 riyals per dollar (YER 2,100 per $1) @ Aden [YE-054] | 2,838 riyals per dollar (2838 ريالاً) [YE-017] | 2,000 riyals per dollar (2000 ريال) [YE-016] | 1,560 riyals per dollar (الدولار يساوي 1560 ريالاً) @ مناطق الحكومة الشرعية [YE-002, YE-003] | 1,562 buy / 1,571 sell (1562 ريالاً للشراء و1571 ريالاً للبيع) @ عدن [YE-020] | 531 buy / 533 sell (531 ريالاً للشراء و533 ريالاً للبيع) @ صنعاء [YE-020, YE-044] | average 1,564.37 buy / 1,572.23 sell (متوسط سعر الشراء 1,564.37 ريال) @ عدن [YE-045]
today: 2,000 riyals per dollar (2000 ريال) + 531 buy / 533 sell (531 ريالاً للشراء و533 ريالاً للبيع) @ صنعاء + average 1,564.37 buy / 1,572.23 sell (متوسط سعر الشراء 1,564.37 ريال) @ عدن + 1,560 riyals per dollar (الدولار يساوي 1560 ريالاً) @ مناطق الحكومة الشرعية

axis: Riyal banknote editions (العملة الجديدة / الطبعة القديمة)
what_varies: Which printings and coins of the riyal may be used, by authority and place.
states: new banknotes banned (منع تداول العملة الجديدة) @ المناطق التي يسيطرون عليها [YE-011] | new banknotes upheld by the Aden central bank (تحذيرًا إلى الشركات اليمنية من الامتثال للحظر) [YE-014] | new banknotes banned (منع تداول العملة الجديدة) @ مناطق سيطرة الحوثيين [YE-023, YE-041] | 100-riyal coins issued by Ansar Allah (newly minted 100 YER coins) [YE-055] | old edition ordered withdrawn (سحب الطبعة القديمة من العملة اليمنية في غضون شهرين) [YE-026, YE-040] | 50-riyal coins and 200-riyal notes issued by Ansar Allah (عملات معدنية جديدة من فئة 50 ريالاً وأوراق نقدية من فئة 200 ريال) [YE-047] | new banknotes banned (newly printed IRG banknotes were banned) @ Ansar Allah-controlled areas [YE-052] | old and new notes treated as two currencies (treated as two separate currencies) [YE-056]
today: old and new notes treated as two currencies (treated as two separate currencies) + new banknotes banned (newly printed IRG banknotes were banned) @ Ansar Allah-controlled areas
note: Sources differ on when the ban began: mid-December 2019 [YE-011] or 2020 [YE-052].

what_varies: The standing of the electronic riyal as a means of payment.
states: in trial since 2018 (بمرحلة تجريبية منذ عام 2018) @ المناطق التي يسيطرون عليها [YE-011, YE-042, YE-012] | dealing warned against by the Aden central bank (التعامل بالريَال الإلكتروني) [YE-014]
today: dealing warned against by the Aden central bank (التعامل بالريَال الإلكتروني) + in trial since 2018 (بمرحلة تجريبية منذ عام 2018) @ المناطق التي يسيطرون عليها

axis: Riyal–Saudi riyal exchange rate (سعر صرف الريال السعودي)
what_varies: How many Yemeni riyals buy one Saudi riyal, in the market or as fixed by a central bank.
states: 755 riyals per Saudi riyal (755 ريالاً) [YE-017] | 500 riyals per Saudi riyal (500 ريال يمني) [YE-016] | 425 buy / 428 sell, fixed by the Aden central bank (425 ريالاً للشراء - 428 ريالاً للبيع) [YE-019] | 410 buy / 413 sell, fixed by the Aden central bank (410 ريالاً للشراء - 413 ريالاً للبيع) [YE-018] | 139.8 buy / 140.2 sell (139.8 ريالاً للشراء و140.2 ريالاً للبيع) @ صنعاء [YE-021] | 411 buy / 413 sell (411 ريالاً للشراء و413 ريالاً للبيع) @ عدن [YE-021] | 139.5 buy / 140.2 sell (139.50 ريال / 140.20 ريال) @ صنعاء [YE-043] | average 411.82 buy / 413.77 sell (متوسط سعر الشراء 411.82 ريال) @ عدن [YE-046]
note: Disputed at the latest date for whole market: 500 riyals per Saudi riyal (500 ريال يمني) vs 425 buy / 428 sell, fixed by the Aden central bank (425 ريالاً للشراء - 428 ريالاً للبيع). The undated Aden central bank rate of 410/413 [YE-018] counts as oldest under rule 5; its own text says it replaced the August 2025 rate [YE-019].

axis: Who may provide e-payment services (مقدمي خدمات الدفع الإلكتروني)
what_varies: Which kinds of institution are allowed to offer electronic payment services.
states: banks only (مقتصرةً فقط على البنوك) [YE-028] | non-bank institutions allowed by the central bank in Sana'a (سمح البنك المركزي في صنعاء للمؤسسات المالية من غير البنوك) [YE-029] | licensed banks and specialised companies, exchange companies barred, under the Aden central bank regulation (بالبنوك المرخص لها بالعمل، والشركات المتخصصة) [YE-032, YE-033]
today: licensed banks and specialised companies, exchange companies barred, under the Aden central bank regulation (بالبنوك المرخص لها بالعمل، والشركات المتخصصة)

axis: Aden central bank ban on Sana'a e-wallets and banks (حظر التعامل)
what_varies: Whether the Aden central bank bars dealing with twelve e-wallets and with banks headquartered in Sana'a.
states: dealing banned (حظر التعامل) [YE-025, YE-026, YE-030, YE-039, YE-040] | ban reversed (ليتراجع البنك لاحقا عن هذا القرار) [YE-031]
today: ban reversed (ليتراجع البنك لاحقا عن هذا القرار)
note: Merged from two candidates (the ban on twelve e-wallets; the suspension of six banks): every source read that gives a state of one gives the matching state of the other [YE-026, YE-030, YE-040].

axis: When buyers pay for online orders
what_varies: Whether an online buyer pays before delivery or on receipt.
states: pay in advance (دفع المبلغ مسبقًا) [YE-022] | pay on delivery (الدفع عند الاستلام) [YE-035, YE-036] | pay on delivery (الدفع عند الاستلام) @ عدن [YE-037, YE-038]

what_varies: Whether Ansar Allah's 20% levy on businesses and citizens is imposed or applied.
states: imposed (فرض الحوثيين "الخُمس") [YE-057, YE-058] | not applied before 2023 (seemingly not applied before 2023) [YE-059]
today: not applied before 2023 (seemingly not applied before 2023)
note: The two sources disagree on 2020–2022: one says imposed [YE-057], the other says seemingly not applied before 2023 [YE-059]. Inference: the second wording implies application from 2023; no source read states it.

what_varies: Whether the Saudi-led coalition controls, delays or blocks imports.
states: controlled, delayed or prevented by the coalition (controlled – and sometimes delayed and prevented – imports) [YE-060] | blockade eased (eased its air, land and maritime blockade) [YE-061]
today: blockade eased (eased its air, land and maritime blockade)
note: Both states are dated 2022 by one source; today follows that source's own order, which puts the easing after the control [YE-061].

axis: US terrorist designation of Ansar Allah (منظمة إرهابية)
what_varies: Whether, and how, the United States designates Ansar Allah a terrorist organisation.
states: designated a foreign terrorist organization (FTO) [YE-063] | designation rescinded (rescinded the designation) [YE-064] | designated a specially designated global terrorist [YE-062] | designated a terrorist organisation by the US and others (منظمة إرهابية) [YE-066, YE-049] | FTO designation process initiated (initiated the FTO-designation process) [YE-065]
today: designated a terrorist organisation by the US and others (منظمة إرهابية)
